discussion.key_messages: - Valley rain and mountain snow will continue through the morning, before shifting to a more showery nature this afternoon and gradually ending. - The heaviest snow accumulations will occur across the southern mountains, where a winter weather advisory continues through 11 AM this morning. - Another colder storm will impact the region Monday evening through Wednesday morning, bringing snow levels as low as 4800 feet to northern Utah. This storm will bring more substantial snow accumulations to the mountains of Utah, with another 6 to 12 inches of snow increasing in probability for the upper Cottonwoods, as well as the southern mountains. - Another even colder system will impact much of Utah Thursday into Saturday. This storm has the highest probability of snow levels down to valley floors (around 60% chance of snow levels at or below 4200 ft by Saturday morning). Current forecast for valley floors is up to an inch of snow.
